subject: Request: Sandbox/top-up + extended trial window due to integration hold
messages:
From: Sara Lewis <slewis@clevercart.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration snag + ask for trial/top-up extension

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our side: the team hit a blocker on the live connector for our checkout flow — the adapter intermittently drops messages when order metadata exceeds 2.1MB. Engineering is already investigating but it looks like a kernel/serialization mismatch in the adapter library that will take a couple of sprints to remediate.

We were scheduled to go into end-to-end billing tests next week, but with this gap our internal rollout will slip at least two weeks. Can Redwood extend our trial window by 3 weeks and add a small sandbox credit top-up so we can finish QA when the fix lands? If you need logs or a trace I attached the error dump and the architecture sketch.

Appreciate any flexibility — we like Redwood’s latency and want to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Sara Lewis
Senior PM, CleverCart
slewis@clevercart.com

Attachments: clevercart-integration-error-log-05-16.txt (text), clevercart-arch-diagram.png (image)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Integration snag + ask for trial/top-up extension

Folks — forwarding Sara's note from CleverCart. TL;DR: connector serialization issue, PO wants +3 weeks on the trial and a small sandbox token top-up (~$2k equivalent) so they can finish QA once the fix is in. They attached an error log and an architecture sketch.

Can we approve a temporary sandbox credit and a +3 week trial extension for CC-2028-058? I think this is a classic runway risk: if we don't keep them moving they could freeze the pilot.

Notes from my side:
- They’re on our recommended host configuration and asked for a short-term top-up only (not an expanded Dedicated).
- Engineering impact looks fixable but not immediate; David, would you estimate effort and whether we need any engineering support from Redwood to workaround in the short term?
- Neha / Finance, let me know if $2k is reasonable to authorize from promo pool. If not, propose an amount.

Thanks — Ben

Ben / Marissa — I looked through the log. Root cause appears to be a chunking edge case in their adapter when payloads include binary invoice attachments. On our side there's a short mitigation we can push: enable a strict prefix-encoding fallback and increase max payload buffer to 4MB for their sandbox pool. That would be a config change (no code change) and we can do it for their sandbox env within a day.

If they accept the config tweak we can keep their tests moving and avoid the full engineering sprint refactor. I'm +1 for the change and the small sandbox credit request.

Estimate: 2 engineer-hours for configuration + review.

-David
David Kim | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.ai

Sara — thanks for the details and the attachments. We can support CleverCart on this. Summary of what we can offer today:

1) Trial extension: +21 days to your current sandbox trial window (new expiration: 2028-06-07).
2) Sandbox credit top-up: $1,800 applied to your sandbox account immediately to cover extended testing and retries.
3) Engineering mitigation: David will apply a prefix-encoding fallback and raise the sandbox buffer to 4MB in the sandbox environment today — no code change required on your side. Expect a short maintenance window of ~30 min.

Next steps:
- Sara, please confirm you’re OK with the config change and the maintenance window.
- If approved, we’ll apply the credit instantly and email the updated billing/trial terms.

Marissa and Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround on approvals. Marissa, please confirm this is within the promo guidelines; Neha, let me know if Finance needs a separate ticket for the $1,800 promo draw.

Sara — if you want the extension formalized in DocuSign I can send a short amendment (I’ve linked the deal below).
